# 8. Ids are generated by the client

**Status:** accepted

## Context

Fulla works on one phone with no backend, and a household can later move to a
shared backend. Anything created offline needs an id before any server exists.

## Decision

Everything a phone can create gets a UUID on the phone. The server accepts
those ids and refuses an id that already belongs to another household.
Recurring occurrences and imported rows get deterministic ids (UUIDv5), so two
phones producing the same occurrence or importing the same statement row
produce the same id.

## Consequences

Moving a household from a phone to a server uploads everything as it is, with
no renumbering, and the upload can be retried safely.
